objective: Analyze a synthetic workflow fault: a chat session spends too long doing heavy reasoning before handing work to an external compute executor. Produce the smallest robust control-plane correction that makes the chat enqueue heavy work quickly, preserves resumability across sessions, and never claims execution without a receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Identify the root control-flow failure in one concise sentence.
Give a 5-step handoff-first workflow with a durable job id and next-action checkpoint.
State one falsifier showing the handoff did not actually occur.
Do not claim access to private state, credentials, Drive contents, or hidden runtime.
falsifier: Fail if the answer recommends keeping heavy reasoning in the chat before dispatch, or treats configured routing as executed compute.
